### 🟡 Changes recommended The v5 suite duplicates inherited tests and starts an unnecessary additional Pulsar broker.
1 open finding - [Avoid duplicate inherited tests and broker startup in V5 suite](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20452#discussion_r4242802437) · New
What changed in this PR Adds Pulsar client v5 integration coverage for issue #20407 while retaining existing 2.8/4.x coverage. **Changes:** - Adds synchronous and asynchronous v5 producer/consumer tests. - Adds v5 dependencies, Muzzle coverage, broker selection, and Java 17 gating. - Registers the suite in CI and latest-dependency configuration. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `PulsarClientV5Test.java` | Tests v5 messaging APIs and telemetry propagation. | | `AbstractPulsarClientTest.java` | Selects a compatible broker image. | | `build.gradle.kts` | Configures v5 dependencies, Muzzle, and test suite. | | `.github/​scripts/​instrumentations.sh` | Adds the v5 suite to CI. | | `.github/​config/​latest-dep-versions.json` | Pins the latest v5 client artifact. |
🧠 **Review effort:** Balanced --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.

[Testing] This suite discovers both `PulsarClientTest` from `src/test/java` and `PulsarClientV5Test`; because both extend `AbstractPulsarClientTest`, JUnit runs the four inherited tests twice and starts a separate Pulsar broker for each class. This adds a costly duplicate container/test cycle. Consider making the v5 class extend `PulsarClientTest` and filtering this suite to execute only that subclass, so it inherits the legacy coverage and adds the v5 cases in one fixture lifecycle.

Pulsar 5 introduces a new API and changes the dependency needed for the retained legacy API. Existing coverage stops at 4.x.

- **Coverage:** Add `version5Test`, reusing legacy tests and exercising synchronous/asynchronous v5 producer and queue-consumer APIs. Assert message IDs, span attributes, and propagated trace links.
- **Runtime:** Use `pulsar-client-v5-all`, compile-only Swagger annotations, and a v5 broker. Gate the suite on Java 17 while preserving 2.8/4.x coverage.
- **Integration:** Register the suite in `check` and CI; add v5 Muzzle coverage and the dependency-version pin.

The two broker versions preserve transaction coverage. The 2.8 client lacks the coordinator-connect handshake required by newer brokers, while the v5 API requires a 5.x broker.

- Fixes #20407
